name: 家用浸塑六角哑铃套组款

category.leaf: 氯丁橡胶浸塑六角哑铃

description: 六角浸塑哑铃套图：成对主图、平头防滚卖点、材质微距与多色矩阵

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool light grey panel #E9ECEF for claim and comparison screens, one warm wood-floored room environment for the lifestyle scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front-left soft key and gentle fill, controlled narrow sheen on the dipped coating, true soft contact shadows, one consistent light direction across every panel
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cool grey studio board #E9ECEF for desk screens, warm oak plank floor #DCC3A3 for the room scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for empty placeholder plates only, no rendered words or digits
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and bare geometric glyph plates in graphite #2B2E33 with one vivid orange #E8622A accent, always left unlabelled
styleLock.presentationRules: same slight 3/4 packshot angle and product scale across the whole set, broad flat end faces always presented blank, pairs laid diagonally or stacked, no product part cropped
noDrift: no legible text, numerals or weight marks anywhere in frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium home-strength ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, cool light grey panel #E9ECEF, graphite charcoal text #2B2E33 and one vivid orange accent #E8622A used sparingly; neutral studio colour temperature; modern geometric sans-serif kept for empty placeholder plates only, no rendered words or digits; clean seamless studio backdrops or one warm wood-floored room, no gradients or random textures; bright even high-key lighting with a front-left soft key, gentle fill, controlled narrow sheen on the dipped coating and true soft contact shadows; thin single-weight line icon style; stable product scale and the same slight 3/4 packshot angle with broad flat end faces kept blank; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索结果里一眼点击，用成对摆位展示成套到手，白底合规无干扰。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 roll, two units laid diagonally side by side, whole pair inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left soft key with bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under every end
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond even margins around the pair
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot photography of {product}, a matched pair of two units. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two units laid diagonally side by side on the floor plane, straight-on eye-level camera with a slight 3/4 roll so both broad flat end faces read as blank planes, the pair complete inside the frame and nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting from the front left with a bounce fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding each end so nothing floats. Seamless studio white #FFFFFF background. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace beyond even margins. Negative: no numerals or letters on the end faces, no brand wordmark, no platform badge or star strip, no props, no hands, no watermark, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no extra duplicated weights, no harsh drop shadows.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清平头端面落地稳、不滚动滚落的核心利益。
shots.camera: very low angle just above the surface, looking slightly upward along the handle into the near flat end face
shots.lighting: bright even key from the upper front left with soft fill, one thin crisp contact shadow under the resting face
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right third for copy placement
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}, a single unit. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The unit sits low in the left half of the frame, photographed from a very low angle just above the surface looking slightly upward along the handle so the near broad end face presents as a flat blank plane resting squarely down. Bright even key from the upper front left with a soft fill, one thin crisp contact shadow under the resting face to prove it sits flat without rocking. Cool light grey panel background #E9ECEF, seamless and plain. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space on the right third and no other elements. Negative: no digits or text on the end face, no tilted or mid-roll stance, no motion blur, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no textured or gradient backdrop.

shots.intent: 用圆头器械滚落与地面凌乱的对照放大收纳与安全隐患。
shots.camera: matched straight-on eye-level framing, identical crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel dim and lower-key, right panel bright even high-key, light direction consistent within each panel
shots.background: left panel graphite charcoal #34383D, right panel seamless studio white #FFFFFF
shots.props: left panel only: a scattered pile of generic unbranded loose round-ended weights and a curled mat
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace inside either panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with an identical straight-on eye-level camera height and crop. Left panel under dim lower-key light: a cluttered corner of generic round-ended loose weights scattered on a dark graphite charcoal #34383D floor, one piece tipped onto its curved end and rolling away, no product identity visible. Right panel under bright even high-key light: {product} resting flat and stable on a seamless studio white #FFFFFF surface with a clean contact shadow. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The scene content occupies 40-50% of each panel with no extra whitespace inside either frame. Negative: no legible text, no numerals, no brand marks, no faces, no hands, no fabricated statistics or damage, no exaggerated mess, no mismatched light direction between panels, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用连续浸塑表层与无缝包边的微距证明握感与做工。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the handle waist and one head shoulder, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft sweeping light skimming the surface from the left at a shallow 45-degree angle, one controlled narrow highlight along the curve
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom where the dipped coating wraps from the handle waist onto the shoulder of one weight head, showing the continuous seamless overmoulded edge and a fine pebbled matte grain. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a shallow 45-degree skim with a macro lens and shallow depth of field, foreground sharp, the far end falling soft. Soft sweeping light skimming across the surface from the left, one controlled narrow highlight travelling along the curve, no blown speculars. Cool neutral studio card background #D7DCE0. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no exposed bare metal, no cracks or peeling edges, no scratches, no legible text or numerals, no plastic-melted artefacts, no props, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把成对器械放进真实居家训练角，让买家代入自家空间。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down across the room corner so the layout reads clearly
shots.lighting: soft natural window light from the upper left at 5500K with warm bounce off the floor, one consistent shadow direction
shots.background: warm oak plank floor #DCC3A3 with a plain off-white wall #F4F2EF and a window edge at the far left
shots.props: a low flat bench, a slim upright rack, a foam roller, a curled mat and a coiled skipping rope, all generic and unbranded, never covering the product
shots.whitespace: the room fills the frame, no added white margin
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} placed on the floor and stood on the rack inside a bright home training corner. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down across the corner so the layout of mat, rack and bench reads clearly with the product as the focal group. Soft natural window light entering from the upper left at 5500K, warm bounce from the timber floor, believable overlapping soft shadows in one consistent direction. Warm oak plank floor #DCC3A3, plain off-white wall #F4F2EF, a low flat bench, a slim upright rack, a foam roller, a curled mat and a coiled skipping rope as generic unbranded props placed behind and beside the product, never covering it. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame while the room fills the rest with no added white margin. Candid documentary framing slightly off centre in a real lived-in room, NOT studio-retouched look. Negative: no readable text or numerals on any equipment or mat, no brand logos on the rack or bench, no bottom promotional band, no platform wordmark, no visible faces, no hands gripping equipment, no deformed fingers, no duplicated racks, no floating objects, no impossible shadows, no watermark, no over-smoothed surfaces.

shots.intent: 保留双栏勾叉对照结构，让买家自行带入普通款与本款差异。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, two matched panels with identical crop, distance and light
shots.lighting: bright even high-key key from the front left, matching soft contact shadows on both panels
shots.background: cool light grey panels #E9ECEF on both sides of a thin divider
shots.props: one bare check-shaped outline plate and one bare cross-shaped outline plate, a thin divider line
shots.whitespace: balanced gutters around both panels, no copy block
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison layout, two matched panels shot with an identical straight-on eye-level camera, crop, distance and lighting, separated by one thin graphite #2B2E33 divider line. Left panel: a generic unbranded loose round-ended weight pair on a cool light grey panel #E9ECEF with a bare blank rounded plate and a thin graphite cross outline beneath it. Right panel: {product} on the same cool light grey panel #E9ECEF with a bare blank rounded plate and a thin vivid orange #E8622A check outline beneath it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even high-key key light from the front left with matching soft contact shadows on both sides so only the subject state differs. The two subjects sit within a 50-60% combined band with balanced gutters and no copy block. Negative: no wording or numerals in either panel, no text inside the glyph plates, no real competitor product or trademark, no fabricated test results or statistics, no mismatched shadows between panels, no arrow labels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用正侧轮廓与空白引线交代单只大小与握位比例，消除尺寸疑虑。
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, one unit laid horizontal dead centre
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, minimal shadow, one soft contact line under the body
shots.props: thin graphite leader lines with blank rounded value chips at the left edge and along the bottom
shots.whitespace: generous clean margin around the silhouette for overlay measurements
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size and silhouette screen, flat lay shot of {product} photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with one unit laid perfectly horizontal dead centre so the outline, the narrow handle waist and both broad flat end faces are read at once. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with minimal shadow and one soft contact line under the body so it stays grounded. Seamless studio white #FFFFFF background. Thin graphite #2B2E33 dimension leader lines with blank rounded value chips at the left edge and along the bottom, both end faces kept blank. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous clean margin around the silhouette. Negative: no numerals, no measurement values or unit marks, no letters or arrows with text, no brand marks, no props, no tilted perspective, no warped straight lines, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 同机位多色并列加空白标签条，让买家按配色与梯度自选组合。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level flat matrix, every pair at the identical slight 3/4 packshot angle
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, identical direction and soft contact shadow on every cell
shots.background: cool pale grey field #DCE1E6 with two rows of empty rounded label bars
shots.props: empty rounded label bars alternating pale grey #E7E7E7 and warm cream #FBF0DC
shots.whitespace: even grid gutters between rows, no headline block at the top
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant matrix of {product}: nine matched pairs arranged in two straight-on rows, five above and four below, every pair rendered at the identical slight 3/4 packshot angle and distance. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pairs differ only in coating colour, hex-pinned across the grid as pink #E9A0B4, violet #7C3FA6, lime #A8C22E, golden yellow #F0C02E, royal blue #2F5DA8, charcoal #2B2E33, slate grey #6E7377 and forest green #2C5340, with dark variants keeping the same matte grain and highlight falloff. Bright even high-key studio lighting with identical direction and one soft contact shadow per unit. Cool pale grey field #DCE1E6 with two rows of empty rounded label bars under the pairs, alternating pale grey #E7E7E7 and warm cream #FBF0DC, all bars left empty. The grid occupies 60-70% of the frame overall with even gutters between rows. Negative: no headline text, no numerals, no weight or size labels, no wording inside the bars, no brand marks, no mixed lighting between cells, no duplicated or fused pairs, no floating units, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用做工实证细节与留空凭证位收尾降风险，不承诺任何资质数据。
shots.camera: clean slight 3/4 product angle with two macro insets, tight zoom on the coating seam and the flat base rim
shots.lighting: even bright studio key from the front left with soft fill and true contact shadows under every panel
shots.props: three empty rounded proof frames in thin graphite lines and one blank circular stamp plate
shots.whitespace: structured margins around the empty proof frames
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}: the main unit at a clean slight 3/4 angle beside two small macro insets, a tight zoom on the seamless dipped edge and another on the flat base rim. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even bright studio key from the front left with soft fill and true contact shadows under every panel. Seamless studio white #FFFFFF background carrying three empty rounded proof frames outlined in thin graphite #2B2E33 lines and one blank circular stamp plate outlined in vivid orange #E8622A, every interior surface left empty. The composition occupies 50-60% of the frame overall with structured margins around the frames. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, lab results or guarantees, no legible words or digits in any frame, no seal lettering, no platform badges or star strips, no real logo, no dense body text, no floating panels, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底成对斜置；002 白底单只斜放、平端面朝向镜头并印磅数字样；003 两只交叉叠放；004 多色多档成对矩阵，顶部英文标语加下方灰与米色标签条印磅数；005 正侧轮廓配两条带英寸数值的引线；006 居家训练角实景（长凳、立式器械架、壶铃、泡沫轴、蓝色垫、跳绳、药球）加底部平台品牌导流横幅。品类判定以图为准：主体为健身用自由重量浸塑哑铃，非瑜伽垫等其他器材，故归「运动户外 / 健身训练」，leaf 取氯丁橡胶浸塑六角哑铃。已剥离：源品牌字与平台字样、底部导流横幅、端面磅数字样、尺寸英寸数值、标语原句、场景内器械上的可读文字与商标、无人物出镜；产品一律以 {product} 占位，所有数值与主张改为空白引线、空白标签条、空白凭证框与空白印章位。
